alignment: Which point of the source the position refers to, as OBS alignment flags added together: 1 left, 2 right, 4 top, 8 bottom, 0 center. `5` is the top-left corner.
anchor_enabled: Whether the anchor placement is visible.
anchor_index: Zero-based position of the anchor placement in its scene, counted from the bottom layer up.
anchor_item_id: Scene item ID that OBS assigned to the anchor placement. Reference it from `item_ids` of @resources/scene_contents.
anchor_scene_name: Name of the scene that holds the anchor placement. It follows a rename of the scene without replacing the source.
anchor_scene_uuid: UUID of the scene that holds the anchor placement, normally `scene_uuid` of @resources/scene. Changing it replaces the resource.
anchor_transform: Position, scale, rotation, crop and bounding box of the anchor placement.
bounds_alignment: Alignment of the source inside its bounding box, using the same flags as `alignment`.
bounds_height: Height of the bounding box in pixels. Use `0` with `OBS_BOUNDS_NONE`.
bounds_width: Width of the bounding box in pixels. Use `0` with `OBS_BOUNDS_NONE`.
collection: Name of the OBS scene collection this resource belongs to. The provider refuses to read or write while OBS has a different collection active. Changing it replaces the resource.
crop_bottom: Pixels cropped from the bottom edge of the source.
crop_left: Pixels cropped from the left edge of the source.
crop_right: Pixels cropped from the right edge of the source.
crop_to_bounds: Whether the source is cropped to its bounding box.
crop_top: Pixels cropped from the top edge of the source.
file: Absolute path of the image file. The provider checks that it is a regular file it can read.
group_item_id: Scene item ID of the group in its scene, normally `item_id` of @resources/group.
group_name: Name of the group that receives the source.
group_uuid: UUID of the group that receives the source, normally `group_uuid` of @resources/group. Changing it replaces the resource.
index: Zero-based position in the filter list of the parent. The provider refuses to displace a filter it does not manage.
input_uuid: UUID that OBS assigned to the source. Use it wherever another resource asks for a source or parent UUID.
item_id: Scene item ID that OBS assigned to this placement. Reference it from `item_ids` of @resources/scene_contents.
kind: OBS kind string of the object, for example `image_source` or `color_filter_v2`. It must match a kind the running OBS has registered. Changing it replaces the resource.
name: Name shown in OBS. Changing it replaces the resource.
observed_group_height: Height in pixels that OBS reports for the group.
observed_group_width: Width in pixels that OBS reports for the group.
observed_source_height: Height in pixels that OBS reports for the source.
observed_source_width: Width in pixels that OBS reports for the source.
parent_name: Name of the source, scene or group that carries the filter. It follows a rename of the parent without replacing the filter.
parent_uuid: UUID of the source, scene or group that carries the filter. Changing it replaces the resource.
placement: Visibility, lock state, order and transform of the placement.
placement.index: Zero-based position in the containing scene or group, counted from the bottom layer up.
placement.locked: Whether the placement is locked against editing in the OBS interface.
scale_x: Horizontal scale factor. `1` is the native width of the source.
scale_y: Vertical scale factor. `1` is the native height of the source.
scene_name: Name of the scene that contains the group. It follows a rename of the scene.
scene_uuid: UUID of the scene that contains the group, normally `scene_uuid` of @resources/scene. Changing it replaces the resource.
transform: Position, scale, rotation, crop and bounding box of the placement. Every field is declared, so nothing about the layout is left to an OBS default.
unload: Whether OBS unloads the image while it is not showing.
x: Horizontal position in pixels of the alignment point, measured from the left edge of the containing scene or group.
y: Vertical position in pixels of the alignment point, measured from the top edge of the containing scene or group.
